The '''Yag'Dhul system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]]. The system was connected to both the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], and the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]].
